card.name: Small words in plant and wildlife descriptions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (for, by, as, in) and month abbreviations in nature-guide text about plant or animal species, where the next word could be 'species' or a species-related term.

modes.label: Linking word after species
modes.description: A short preposition right after the phrase 'native plant species' or 'available species' in plant list text.

modes.label: Wildlife descriptions
modes.description: Small linking words or a gap before a count or description of animals.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the word 'species' and related taxonomy words coming next.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in plant and animal guides, and makes the word 'species' less likely next.
